domain_hint: RANS CFD of a UAV intake duct for AIP pressure recovery and distortion
ambiguity_notes:
- Mesh convergence: claims of <2% change conflict with earlier 3.9% medium-to-fine difference and a fine-grid rerun giving 0.978 vs 0.986.
- Boundary condition specification: inlet turbulence intensity stated as both 0.5% and 3%.
- Validation agreement: stated “within 0.1” of rig mean conflicts with revised blockage-corrected data showing ~2% overprediction.
- Numerical method choices/repeatability: compressible vs incompressible density setting and AMG preconditioner changes alter recovery by ~1–1.5% despite a claim of 0.2% platform-to-platform repeatability.
